input.command:
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && export PYTHONPATH=/root/nlp_variance_gtheory:$PYTHONPATH && cd /root/nlp_variance_gtheory && python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
import json

# 读取 shard_3 的 design CSV
design = pd.read_csv('results/exp001_qwen/shards/shard_3.csv')
print(f'Design has {len(design)} conditions')

# 读取已完成的 shard_3 数据
records = []
with open('results/exp001_qwen/shard_3.jsonl') as f:
    for line in f:
        records.append(json.loads(line))
df = pd.DataFrame(records)
print(f'Completed: {len(df)} records, {df[\"condition_id\"].nunique()} conditions')

# 找出缺失的 condition_ids
completed_cids = set(df['condition_id'].unique())
all_cids = set(design['condition_id'])
missing_cids = sorted(all_cids - completed_cids)
print(f'Missing conditions: {len(missing_cids)}')
print(f'Missing IDs: {missing_cids}')

# 生成补跑 design CSV
patch_design = design[design['condition_id'].isin(missing_cids)]
patch_design.to_csv('results/exp001_qwen/shards/shard_3_patch.csv', index=False)
print(f'Patch design: {len(patch_design)} conditions saved')
"
